title: Chapter Twenty-Nine: There Is No Despair in the World at All!

segments.he: רַק שֶׁיִּתְפַּרְסֵם שְׁמוֹ בְּכָל הָעוֹלָם, זֶהוּ הַשֵּׁם שֶׁלּוֹ - נַ נַחְ, זֶהוּ כּוֹלֵל בּוֹ כָּל הַגְּאֻלָּה וְכָל הַיְּשׁוּעוֹת כָּלוּל בְּזֶה הַשֵּׁם, כִּי הָעִקַּר תָּלוּי בְּרַבֵּנוּ. הָעִקַּר הַגְּאֻלָּה, עִקַּר בִּיאַת הַמָּשִׁיחַ תָּלוּי בְּקִרְבַת הַצַּדִּיקִים. שֶׁיֵּדְעוּ הָעוֹלָם שֶׁיֵּשׁ צַדִּיקִים כָּאֵלֶּה - רַבֵּנוּ וְתַלְמִידָיו, רַבֵּנוּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ וַאֲנָשָׁיו. זֶה עִקַּר הַגְאֻלָּה תָּלוּי בָּזֶה. זֶה מֻתָּר לְהוֹדִיעַ, לְפַרְסֵם לְכָל עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל, כֵּן.
segments.en: The Petek contains a power of strengthening that lifts a person from the very depths of the fall to the ultimate heights. When I found the Petek in the book — the meaning was: I still have hope!

segments.he: כָּל הָעוֹלָם לֹא יָדַע מִנַּ נַחְ, לֹא דֻבַּר בְּשׁוּם סֵפֶר מִזֶּה, מֵעוֹלָם לֹא הָיָה שׁוּם צַדִּיק שֶׁחָתַם חֲתִימָה כָּזֶה שֶׁל פָּשׁוּט כָּפוּל מְשֻׁלָּשׁ מְרֻבָּע. זֶה פֶּלֶא כָּזֶה.. רַק הוּא בְּעַצְמוֹ גִּלָּה אֶת עַצְמוֹ - שֶׁזֶּה נַ נַחְ נַחְמָ נַחְמָן מֵאוּמַן.
segments.en: Our holy Rabbenu revealed and cried out with a great voice: "Oy, oy, oy… Do not despair! There is no despair in the world at all!" Even though I had eaten before the prayer and done such a thing — even I still have hope.

segments.he: וְרַבֵּנוּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ גַּם-כֵּן בְּחַיָּיו לֹא חָתַם כָּכָה, זֶה נִכְתַּב בַּ'לִּקּוּטֵי מוֹהֲרַ"ן' וְרַבֵּנוּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ מְדַבֵּר מֵהַשִּׁיר הַזֶּה, אֲבָל לֹא יָדַעְנוּ מִזֶּה, זֶה רַק בְּהַפֶּתֶק הַזֶּה. וְכָאן הוּא מְגַלֶּה בְּפֵרוּשׁ לִפְנֵי כָּל הָעוֹלָם: נַ נַחְ נַחְמָ נַחְמָן מֵאוּמַן, הוּא בְּעַצְמוֹ זֶה הַשִּׁיר שֶׁיַּחֲזִיר כָּל הָעוֹלָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ...
segments.en: Nu — I took this upon myself then: "There is no despair in the world at all." I drew strength from this to stand against this darkness, against this trouble — I had eaten before the prayer. Even though I had done such a thing — nonetheless: "There is no despair in the world at all." Begin now anew to be a Jew.

segments.he: רַבֵּנוּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ - בִּזְמַן שֶׁהוּא בָּא לָעוֹלָם, אָז הַמַּפְתֵּחַ שֶׁל כָּל הַגְּאֻלָּה אֶצְלוֹ, בּוֹ תָּלוּי כָּל הַגְּאֻלָּה. כֵּן, כָּל הַגְּאֻלָּה בִּכְלָלִי בִּפְרָטִי לְכָל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל. בִּיאַת הַמָּשִׁיחַ תָּלוּי בּוֹ. אֲבָל לְגַלּוֹת בְּפֵרוּשׁ שֶׁאֲנִי הוּא - זֶה רַק בְּהַפֶּתֶק הַזֶּה!
segments.en: The meaning of the Petek is such great strengthening for everyone. To receive a Petek from Rabbenu — this is a wonder that has never before been in the world. This is a great and awesome novelty as Rabbenu says: "A novelty like me has never yet been in the world." Likutay Moharan is full of strengthening — all the Torah portions contain only strengthening: not to despair and to begin anew every moment. Nu — and I know of this, I study this, I walked with this. And suddenly all this strength was cut off from me through the fall — through the eating on the seventeenth of Tammuz. Not a single word of Rabbenu helped me. I fell into such darkness that I had no healing at all. And this Petek was my healing. They said to me: "Open the book and there you will find healing for your soul." And from that time the illness left completely — and the healing has continued all the days of my life!

segments.he: רַבִּי נַחְמָן הוּא הַשֹּׁרֶשׁ שֶׁלָּנוּ וְשֶׁל כָּל הָעוֹלָם. בּוֹ וּבִשְׁמוֹ נַ נַחְ נַחְמָ נַחְמָן מֵאוּמַן, זֶה הַשֹּׁרֶשׁ שֶׁל כָּל הַבְּרִיאָה, שֶׁל כָּל הַתּוֹרָה וְשֶׁל הַכֹּל. וְזֶה מְסֻגָּל לַחֲזֹר בִּתְשׁוּבָה וּלְכָל הַיְשׁוּעוֹת. צְרִיכִים לְהָבִין שֶׁזֶּה מְסֻגָּל, כִּי הוּא הַשֹּׁרֶשׁ שֶׁל הַגְּאֻלָּה וְהַשֹּׁרֶשׁ שֶׁל כָּל נַפְשׁוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל, לְהַחֲזִירָם לְהוֹצִיאָם מִמְּקוֹמוֹת כָּאֵלּוּ.. כָּל אֶחָד מֵהֵיכָן שֶׁנָּפַל לְשָׁם. לְהוֹצִיא כָּל אֶת הָעוֹלָם מֵהַצָּרוֹת. הַצָּרוֹת הֵם הַתַּאֲווֹת וְהַכֶּסֶף וְתַעֲנוּגֵי הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה. וְלֹא צְרִיכִים אֶת הַכֹּל, צְרִיכִים לֶאֱכֹל חֲתִיכַת לֶחֶם. בִּשְׁבִיל מָה כָּל הַכֶּסֶף וְהַבִּנְיָנִים?
segments.en: This is a thing impossible to describe or tell — the matter of the sadness I had, and then such joy. And it gave me healing — the opposite of sadness. And this brought me new life — a life of joy always, all the days of my life. Whenever I received a blow — I immediately took the Petek and everything was annulled and I became joyful. Every time something passed over me — in body, in soul, in falls, in descents — immediately I took the Petek and read it. And already there was healing. I saw that a different matter happened — a new song was made. And it is like new to me. It comforts me, heals me from all the illnesses — in body and soul. And that is all.

aligned_segments.he: וְכָאן הוּא מְגַלֶּה בְּפֵרוּשׁ לִפְנֵי כָּל הָעוֹלָם: נַ נַחְ נַחְמָ נַחְמָן מֵאוּמַן, הוּא בְּעַצְמוֹ זֶה הַשִּׁיר שֶׁיַּחֲזִיר כָּל הָעוֹלָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ...
aligned_segments.en: Even though I had done such a thing — nonetheless: "There is no despair in the world at all." Begin now anew to be a Jew.

aligned_segments.he: רַבֵּנוּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ - בִּזְמַן שֶׁהוּא בָּא לָעוֹלָם, אָז הַמַּפְתֵּחַ שֶׁל כָּל הַגְּאֻלָּה אֶצְלוֹ, בּוֹ תָּלוּי כָּל הַגְּאֻלָּה.
aligned_segments.en: The meaning of the Petek is such great strengthening for everyone. To receive a Petek from Rabbenu — this is a wonder that has never before been in the world.

aligned_segments.he: כֵּן, כָּל הַגְּאֻלָּה בִּכְלָלִי בִּפְרָטִי לְכָל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל.
aligned_segments.en: This is a great and awesome novelty as Rabbenu says: "A novelty like me has never yet been in the world." Likutay Moharan is full of strengthening — all the Torah portions contain only strengthening: not to despair and to begin anew every moment. Nu — and I know of this, I study this, I walked with this.
And suddenly all this strength was cut off from me through the fall — through the eating on the seventeenth of Tammuz. Not a single word of Rabbenu helped me.

aligned_segments.he: אֲבָל לְגַלּוֹת בְּפֵרוּשׁ שֶׁאֲנִי הוּא - זֶה רַק בְּהַפֶּתֶק הַזֶּה!
aligned_segments.en: I fell into such darkness that I had no healing at all. And this Petek was my healing. They said to me: "Open the book and there you will find healing for your soul." And from that time the illness left completely — and the healing has continued all the days of my life!

aligned_segments.he: רַבִּי נַחְמָן הוּא הַשֹּׁרֶשׁ שֶׁלָּנוּ וְשֶׁל כָּל הָעוֹלָם.
aligned_segments.en: This is a thing impossible to describe or tell — the matter of the sadness I had, and then such joy.

aligned_segments.he: בּוֹ וּבִשְׁמוֹ נַ נַחְ נַחְמָ נַחְמָן מֵאוּמַן, זֶה הַשֹּׁרֶשׁ שֶׁל כָּל הַבְּרִיאָה, שֶׁל כָּל הַתּוֹרָה וְשֶׁל הַכֹּל.
aligned_segments.en: And it gave me healing — the opposite of sadness.

aligned_segments.he: וְזֶה מְסֻגָּל לַחֲזֹר בִּתְשׁוּבָה וּלְכָל הַיְשׁוּעוֹת.
aligned_segments.en: And this brought me new life — a life of joy always, all the days of my life.

aligned_segments.he: צְרִיכִים לְהָבִין שֶׁזֶּה מְסֻגָּל, כִּי הוּא הַשֹּׁרֶשׁ שֶׁל הַגְּאֻלָּה וְהַשֹּׁרֶשׁ שֶׁל כָּל נַפְשׁוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל, לְהַחֲזִירָם לְהוֹצִיאָם מִמְּקוֹמוֹת כָּאֵלּוּ..
aligned_segments.en: Whenever I received a blow — I immediately took the Petek and everything was annulled and I became joyful.
Every time something passed over me — in body, in soul, in falls, in descents — immediately I took the Petek and read it.

aligned_segments.he: הַצָּרוֹת הֵם הַתַּאֲווֹת וְהַכֶּסֶף וְתַעֲנוּגֵי הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה.
aligned_segments.en: I saw that a different matter happened — a new song was made.

aligned_segments.he: וְלֹא צְרִיכִים אֶת הַכֹּל, צְרִיכִים לֶאֱכֹל חֲתִיכַת לֶחֶם.
aligned_segments.en: And it is like new to me.
It comforts me, heals me from all the illnesses — in body and soul. And that is all.
